en: Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not resultant, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is not resultant, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are forty-nine... [etc. ... under prenascence and repetition there are forty-eight... [etc. ... under non-disappearance there are forty-nine. (Abbreviated.)
